AGI.moat_txt: Top-2 India container-glass and specialty-packaging maker with premium-glass and closures capability; capital- and energy-intensive.
AGI.bull: Spirits/beer premiumisation, food-pharma glass demand and industry consolidation (HNG).
AGI.bear: Energy-cost cyclicality, heavy capex and HNG-acquisition litigation.

ASAHIINDIA.moat_txt: India's largest integrated glass company and dominant auto-glass supplier (~70% OEM share) with AGC technology and Maruti/Suzuki backing.
ASAHIINDIA.bull: Auto premiumisation, architectural glass demand and value-added mix.
ASAHIINDIA.bear: Auto cyclicality, float-glass leverage and rich valuation.

MMFL.moat_txt: Mid-tier CV/off-highway steel-forging exporter with integrated machining and a diversified global customer base.
MMFL.bull: Global CV recovery, export/China+1 and machining value-addition.
MMFL.bear: Deep CV cyclicality, export concentration and leverage.

AGI.why: Scaled, profitable container-glass leader with premium/closures optionality; trails only unlisted Piramal Glass on premium breadth.

ASAHIINDIA.why: Dominant OEM auto-glass share with AGC technology and float integration; a near-duopoly with Saint-Gobain.

MMFL.why: Solid mid-tier CV/export forger with integrated machining, but sub-scale and more cyclical/levered than Bharat Forge or Ramkrishna.
